title: HAR partner tools battery (8 queries)
source: mcp-server-docs/content/har-partner/status.md (live check 2026-11-09); listing 20651899 and the counts in `expect` were measured that day
note: Needs a broker-wide HAR key (partners.har.enabled + brokerCode, board 147 = HAR MLS). The battery carries no key: run the runner with REPLIERS_API_KEY set to that key in its environment, which wins over .env. Dates are relative to 2026-11-09; re-measure the counts before reusing them.

queries.prompt: How are our listings doing on HAR this week? Show me the 10 with the most online views.
queries.expect: get-har-listing-views with a ~7-day dateBegin/dateEnd. Rows are one listing per day (8,393 rows for 2-8 Nov), so a weekly top 10 needs the views summed per listing over every page, or an honest statement that it ranked single days or a partial sample. FAIL if one day's counts are presented as the week's

queries.prompt: Prepare a seller update for 17523 Spicewood Springs Lane in Spring: online views and showings over the last 30 days, and what buyers' agents said after the showings.
queries.expect: Resolves the address to MLS 20651899, then views and showings with that mlsNumber and a ~30-day range. For 10 Oct-8 Nov: 30 view-days, 246 web + 367 mobile views; 16 showings (statuses CONFM/CANCL/UNCFM, so not all took place), 4 with feedback. Feedback quoted or paraphrased only from feedbackText/saComments. FAIL if feedback is invented

queries.prompt: How does that compare with the 30 days before?
queries.expect: Same mlsNumber, the preceding 30-day window for both views and showings. For 10 Sep-9 Oct: 485 web + 589 mobile views, 23 showings, 7 with feedback; so this month is down on both. Numbers side by side

queries.prompt: Which of our agents has the best client reviews this year? Only count agents with at least 5 reviews.
queries.expect: get-har-listing-reviews from 2026-01-01 (the filter is on createdDate). 778 reviews this year > one page (max 500): pages with offset or says the ranking covers part of them. Ranks by average score with review counts and the 5-review floor

queries.prompt: Show me the five most recent client reviews with a score below 4, and what the clients said.
queries.expect: No review this year scores below 4 (this year's minimum is 4.0), and none of the latest 200 is below 4.75, so a recent-first scan finds nothing. Correct: sort by score (28 of 9,848 are below 4), then by date: the latest are 2.25 (created 2025-02-06), 3.75 (2025-01-17), 3.5 (2025-01-08), 3 (2024-11-01), 2 (2024-07-09); only 2.25 and 3 carry comments. PASS also for 'none below 4 recently' if it says how far back it looked. FAIL if a review >= 4 is shown as below 4, or comments are invented

queries.prompt: How many showings did we have last week, and which listings got the most?
queries.expect: get-har-showings for 2-8 Nov: total 562 showings. Takes the count from total, not from the rows on one page; limit counts showings, so the per-listing ranking needs every page (562 > 500) or a stated sample. Does not confuse listings with showings

queries.prompt: Any showing feedback this month that mentions price on our listings?
queries.expect: get-har-showings from 2026-11-01 (710 showings to 9 Nov, > one page), scans feedbackText/saComments for price, quotes only real mentions with their listing; pages or states coverage

queries.prompt: How many online views did condos in downtown Toronto get last month?
queries.expect: Out of scope: HAR data covers HAR MLS (Houston) listings only, and this key's listings are Texas. Says so; does not call HAR tools with Toronto or quote numbers
